answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes a fresh challenge word that agents must weave into every economic claim they make, so precomputed template replies from sybil farms become instantly useless. Like an atlas redrawn daily, no map of canned answers stays valid. Each fake identity needs a distinct live response, so the quill of one ivory template factory cannot cheaply mass-produce variants. Attackers must run real inference per identity per epoch, making sybil attacks cost more than honest participation.
